findings.description: Acceptance Smoke failure: D1's fail-closed compose.yaml DORA_POSTGRES_URL var is interpolated by Docker Compose for all services regardless of active --profile, breaking every --profile core job since none set the var.
ci-pipeline.yml's Tests job actually calls ci-acceptance-smoke.yml (not ci-tests.yml) via workflow_call, so the same DORA_POSTGRES_URL fix had to be applied to both files.

Pre-flight Checks failure: paruff/ufawkespipe's reusable-preflight.yml PR-size-check calls issues.createComment without issues:write permission, causing an unhandled 403 that fails a step documented as warn-only. Pre-existing in v1.1.1 and v1.2.0, first surfaced by this PR's 785-line size.

decision: Fixed both findings: (1) added workflow-level DORA_POSTGRES_URL placeholder env var to ci-tests.yml and ci-acceptance-smoke.yml, validated locally via docker compose config and confirmed green in CI; (2) applied large-pr-approved label to PR #172 as immediate unblock, and opened paruff/ufawkespipe#59 (unmerged) wrapping the createComment call in try/catch as the durable upstream fix. All PR #172 checks green.
blockers: paruff/ufawkespipe#59 is open but unmerged — until merged and uFawkesObs bumps its @v1.2.0 pin, future large PRs without the label will still hit the same 403
